sentences.text: Stephen Vincent Strange , M.D. is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	superhero	superhero

Created by artist Steve Ditko and writer Stan Lee , the character first appeared in Strange Tales # 110 -LRB- cover-dated July 1963 -RRB- .	Strange Tales	Strange Tales	Stan Lee	Stan Lee	Steve Ditko	Steve Ditko
Doctor Strange serves as the Sorcerer Supreme , the primary protector of Earth against magical and mystical threats .	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange (film)

Inspired by stories of black magic and Chandu the Magician , Strange was created during the Silver Age of Comics to bring a different kind of character and themes of mysticism to Marvel Comics .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	magic	Magic in fiction	black magic	black magic	Chandu the Magician	Chandu the Magician (radio)	Silver Age of Comics	Silver Age of Comics	mysticism	mysticism
The character 's origin story relates that he was once a brilliant but egotistical surgeon .
After a car accident severely damages his hands and hinders his ability to perform surgery , he searches the globe for a way to repair them and encounters the Ancient One .	Ancient One	Ancient One
After becoming one of the old Sorcerer Supreme 's students , he becomes a practitioner of both the mystical arts as well as martial arts .	martial arts	martial arts

Along with knowing many powerful spells , he has a costume with two mystical objects -- the Cloak of Levitation and Eye of Agamotto -- which give him added powers .	Cloak of Levitation	Cloak of Levitation	Eye of Agamotto	Eye of Agamotto
Strange is aided along the way by his friend and valet , Wong , and a large assortment of mystical objects .	Wong	Wong (comics)
He takes up residence in a mansion called the Sanctum Sanctorum , located in New York City .	Sanctum Sanctorum	Sanctum Sanctorum	New York City	New York City
Later , Strange takes the title of Sorcerer Supreme .

In 2008 , Doctor Strange was ranked 83rd in Wizards `` 200 Greatest Comic Book Characters of All Time '' list , and in 2012 was ranked 33rd in IGN 's list of `` The Top 50 Avengers '' .	Avengers	Avengers (comics)	IGN	IGN	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange (film)
He was also ranked 38th on IGN 's list of `` Top 100 Comic Book Heroes '' .	IGN	IGN
The character was first portrayed in live-action by Peter Hooten in the 1978 television film Dr. Strange .	Peter Hooten	Peter Hooten	Dr. Strange	Dr. Strange (film)

Benedict Cumberbatch stars as the character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe , first appearing in the role in the 2016 film Doctor Strange .	Benedict Cumberbatch	Benedict Cumberbatch	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Doctor Strange	Doctor Strange (film)
